context: STUDY DESIGN Cohort study; Level of evidence, 3. METHODS The study was performed with 18 transplanted menisci (6 medial, 12 lateral) from 16 patients. Eight menisci were transplanted immediately after meniscectomy (IM group); 10 menisci, from patients who complained of knee symptoms at a mean time of 35 months (range, 9-92 months) after total meniscectomy, underwent delayed transplantation (DE group).
target: Fourteen patients undergoing meniscectomy during the same period were included as controls (ME group).
